prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line plate for the heritage collection Fanggu. Image 1 is LINE STYLE ONLY, the Vairocana contour master. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY. Create a refined sparse BLACK INK line drawing on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Match elegant delicate thin organic contours, restrained internal detail, generous white surfaces. No fills, shadows, grey shading, crosshatching, grain, paper texture, gradients, halos or checkerboards. Door recesses are outlines, not black blocks. Show the selected subject complete and centered with 8% margins, verticals vertical and minimal perspective; photograph fixes identity and proportions. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, clutter and sky. No letters, calligraphy, labels, captions, border or watermark. The single raised THEATRE stage in photo: central high hip-and-gable roof, lower projecting side eaves, four facade columns dividing three stage bays, richly carved raised balcony and central circular relief on backdrop. Remove connected courtyard wings and all umbrellas. Landscape 1536x1024, building about 82% width.
